set.body: Earn the public calibration claim with exported product-oracle tests, generative null/signal coverage, realistic frame/feature scale gates, documentation, and entry-path teaching. Acceptance: the lm_relation_fit path is runnable end to end; the precomputed-beta path explains its missing error channel; naive pair-edge SEs are explicitly rejected; citations and assumptions are precise; certification distinguishes algebraic, numerical, statistical, and scale evidence.
set.title: Epic C: Validate and teach calibrated evidence
